formula_text: v = (a + b * U_br^2 / (Ts - Tf))^e  with  U_br = U_measured / m + Uoffset  (SVMtec manual Hitzdraht_doku.pdf, section 6.5, eq. 2 and 3)

source_data.description: Coefficients copied unchanged from the table that was hard-coded in read_hotwire.py (most likely the SVMtec manufacturer calibration). The original calibration data is not in this repository, so there are no data files, hashes or error margins.
